<!-- branding stylesheets -->

<link rel="stylesheet" href="{ basePath }/assets/styles/dxp-site-spacing-styling-hooks.min.css?{ versionKey }" />
<link rel="stylesheet" href="{ basePath }/assets/styles/dxp-styling-hooks.min.css?{ versionKey }" />
<link rel="stylesheet" href="{ basePath }/assets/styles/dxp-slds-extensions.min.css?{ versionKey }" />



<!-- branding stylesheets -->

<!-- General -->
<link rel="icon" href="{ basePath }/sfsites/c/resource/favicon?{ versionKey }" type="image/x-icon" />
<link rel="shortcut icon" href="{ basePath }/sfsites/c/resource/favicon?{ versionKey }" type="image/x-icon" />
<link rel="stylesheet" href="{basePath}/assets/css/theme2.css?{versionKey}">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="{ styles }/styles.css" />

<!-- Category tiles hover effect (Shop By Category carousel only: scoped by the carousel-card ancestor so PLP product cards are not affected) -->
<style>
  b2c_lite_commerce-carousel-card-ui commerce_search-product-card {
    display: block;
    border-radius: 6px;
    overflow: hidden;
    transition: transform 180ms ease-out, box-shadow 180ms ease-out, filter 180ms ease-out;
  }
  b2c_lite_commerce-carousel-card-ui commerce_search-product-card:hover,
  b2c_lite_commerce-carousel-card-ui commerce_search-product-card:focus-within {
    transform: scale(1.04);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #19E08B, 0 8px 24px rgba(25, 224, 139, 0.35);
    filter: brightness(1.1);
  }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    b2c_lite_commerce-carousel-card-ui commerce_search-product-card,
    b2c_lite_commerce-carousel-card-ui commerce_search-product-card:hover,
    b2c_lite_commerce-carousel-card-ui commerce_search-product-card:focus-within {
      transition: none;
      transform: none;
    }
  }
</style>

<!-- Login page (Proposal A brand panel) — selectors only exist on the login view -->
<style>
  .lvlup-login-panel {
    min-height: 86vh;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: space-between;
    padding: 2.8rem 2.5rem;
    border-radius: 12px;
    overflow: hidden;
    position: relative;
    background:
      radial-gradient(120% 90% at 15% 10%, rgba(109, 40, 217, 0.32), transparent 60%),
      radial-gradient(100% 80% at 90% 100%, rgba(25, 224, 139, 0.10), transparent 55%),
      linear-gradient(150deg, #1C2049 0%, #11132C 70%);
  }
  .lvlup-login-panel::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
    background: repeating-linear-gradient(-45deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.018) 0 2px, transparent 2px 34px);
  }
  .lvlup-login-panel > * { position: relative; z-index: 1; }
  .lvlup-login-logo { width: 240px; max-width: 60%; display: block; margin: 0 0 2.5rem; }
  .lvlup-login-tagline {
    font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif;
    font-size: 2.4rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    line-height: 1.25;
    letter-spacing: -0.01em;
    color: #FFFFFF;
    margin: 0;
    max-width: 460px;
  }
  .lvlup-login-tagline .neon { color: #19E08B; }
  .lvlup-login-points { list-style: none; margin: 2rem 0 0; padding: 0; }
  .lvlup-login-points li { color: #C6C9E8; font-size: 1.05rem; margin: 1rem 0; }
  .lvlup-login-points .chev { color: #19E08B; font-weight: 800; margin-right: 0.55rem; }
  .lvlup-login-foot { color: #7D82B8; font-size: 0.8rem; margin: 2rem 0 0; }
  .lvlup-login-card-head {
    width: 420px;
    max-width: calc(100% - 2rem);
    margin: 14vh auto 0;
    background: #1C2049;
    border: 1px solid rgba(109, 40, 217, 0.35);
    border-bottom: none;
    border-radius: 10px 10px 0 0;
    padding: 2rem 2rem 0.2rem;
  }
  .lvlup-login-card-head h1 {
    font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif;
    font-size: 1.7rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #FFFFFF;
    margin: 0 0 0.3rem;
  }
  .lvlup-login-card-head p { color: #9AA0CF; font-size: 0.9rem; margin: 0; }
  community_builder-html-editor:has(.lvlup-login-card-head) { margin-bottom: 0 !important; }
  community_login-login-form {
    display: block;
    width: 420px;
    max-width: calc(100% - 2rem);
    margin: 0 auto !important;
    background: #1C2049;
    border: 1px solid rgba(109, 40, 217, 0.35);
    border-top: none;
    border-bottom: none;
    border-radius: 0;
    padding: 0.6rem 2rem 1rem;
  }
  community_login-login-form button {
    background: #19E08B !important;
    border-color: #19E08B !important;
    color: #06281C !important;
    font-weight: 700;
  }
  community_login-login-form button:hover {
    background: #39E99E !important;
    border-color: #39E99E !important;
  }
  community_login-login-form a {
    color: #854BDF;
    display: block;
    text-align: center;
  }
  community_login-login-form div,
  community_login-login-form hr {
    border-width: 0 !important;
    box-shadow: none !important;
  }
  community_login-login-form label {
    color: #C6C9E8 !important;
    background: transparent !important;
    display: block;
    margin-bottom: 0.35rem;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
  }
  community_login-login-form lightning-input,
  community_login-login-form [part='input-text'],
  community_login-login-form .slds-form-element,
  community_login-login-form .slds-form-element__control,
  community_login-login-form .comm-login-form__container {
    background: transparent !important;
  }
  community_login-login-form .comm-login-form__container { padding: 0 !important; }
  community_login-login-form .comm-login-form__link-section {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    text-align: center;
  }
  community_login-login-form div:has(> input) { background: transparent !important; }
  community_login-login-form input {
    background: #FFFFFF !important;
    border: 1px solid #E5E5E5 !important;
    border-radius: 8px !important;
    color: #1A1A1A !important;
    min-height: 3rem;
    font-size: 1rem;
  }
  .lvlup-login-card-foot {
    width: 420px;
    max-width: calc(100% - 2rem);
    margin: 0 auto;
    background: #1C2049;
    border: 1px solid rgba(109, 40, 217, 0.35);
    border-top: none;
    border-radius: 0 0 10px 10px;
    padding: 0.2rem 2rem 1.6rem;
    text-align: center;
  }
  .lvlup-login-card-foot hr {
    border: none;
    border-top: 1px solid rgba(169, 173, 214, 0.22);
    margin: 0.2rem 0 1rem;
  }
  .lvlup-login-card-foot p { color: #9AA0CF; font-size: 0.9rem; margin: 0; }
  .lvlup-login-card-foot a { color: #19E08B !important; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; }
  .lvlup-login-card-foot a:hover { color: #39E99E !important; }
  community_login-login-form input:focus {
    border-color: #19E08B !important;
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(25, 224, 139, 0.25) !important;
  }
  @media (max-width: 767px) {
    .lvlup-login-panel { min-height: auto; padding: 1.4rem 1.2rem; border-radius: 10px; }
    .lvlup-login-points, .lvlup-login-foot { display: none; }
    .lvlup-login-logo { margin: 0 auto 0.8rem; }
    .lvlup-login-tagline { font-size: 1.1rem; text-align: center; }
    .lvlup-login-card-head { margin-top: 1.2rem; }
  }
</style>

<!-- Category grid card (PLP): la SKU, la marca y el precio los pinta c-lvlup-product-price para controlar el layout (SKU + badge de descuento en una misma fila de 2 columnas). El card estandar se conserva solo por el nombre y el corazon de wishlist; su SKU y su marca se ocultan. Scoped a la card del grid via :has(+ c-lvlup-product-price); el Wishlist y el resto del sitio no se afectan. -->
<style>
  c-lvlup-product-image,
  c-lvlup-product-price,
  commerce_builder-product-card:has(+ c-lvlup-product-price) {
    margin-bottom: 0 !important;
  }
  commerce_builder-product-card:has(+ c-lvlup-product-price) .slds-m-top_small {
    margin-top: 0 !important;
  }
  commerce_builder-product-card:has(+ c-lvlup-product-price) .card-actions-area {
    display: none !important;
  }
  /* El nombre se pinta en un rich-text output con padding propio; se resetea para que comparta borde izquierdo con la SKU/marca/precio de nuestro componente. */
  commerce_builder-product-card:has(+ c-lvlup-product-price) .slds-rich-text-editor__output {
    padding: 0 !important;
  }
  /* SKU y marca del card estandar ocultos: los renderiza c-lvlup-product-price para poder poner SKU y badge en una misma fila. */
  commerce_builder-product-card:has(+ c-lvlup-product-price) commerce-product-info .slds-text-body_small,
  commerce_builder-product-card:has(+ c-lvlup-product-price) .dynamic-fields-area {
    display: none !important;
  }
</style>
